name: openmetadata-skills
description: OpenMetadata discovery tier: a unidirectional push of this repository's ontology, deep column lineage, glossary, and facet tags into a catalog UI, plus the agent surface for querying it.

upstream.note: Every submodule points at a PackMaaan fork so a pin survives an upstream force-push, deleted tag, or rename. A fork never carries a commit upstream does not have; scripts/sync_submodules.py --verify-upstream asserts it.

submodules.external/OpenMetadata: fork of open-metadata/OpenMetadata at tag 1.13.3-release — JSON schemas the emitted payloads are validated against
submodules.external/OpenMetadataStandards: fork of open-metadata/OpenMetadataStandards — OWL ontology the RDF alignment's om: terms are validated against
submodules.external/openmetadata-dbt-action: fork of open-metadata/openmetadata-dbt-action — reference: the dbt ingestion workflow shape
submodules.external/openmetadata-demo: fork of open-metadata/openmetadata-demo — reference: API-lineage and MCP patterns
submodules.external/openmetadata-ai-sdk: fork of open-metadata/ai-sdk (renamed) — reference: agent surface shape
submodules.external/openmetadata-sqllineage: fork of open-metadata/openmetadata-sqllineage — reference: evaluated, not adopted
submodules.external/openmetadata-retention: fork of open-metadata/openmetadata-retention — reference: evaluated, not adopted
submodules.external/collate-dbt-artifacts-parser: fork of open-metadata/collate-dbt-artifacts-parser — reference: evaluated, not adopted

upstream.runtime: openmetadata-ingestion[dbt]==1.13.3.0 (optional; must match the server version)
